name: shiori-notes
title_zh: 给 Shiori 笔记库写 HTML 的排版师傅
tagline_zh: 手写笔记常被样式拖垮：内联 CSS 越堆越乱，链接一改全断。它按库内既有风格出紧凑样式，ID 稳定、链接相对。
tagline_en: Stops messy inline CSS and broken links in hand-written notes. Reuses your vault's tags, keeps IDs stable, links.
desc_en: Create or edit HTML notes for a shiori vault, including clear prose, compact shared styling, stable IDs, existing tags, relative links, and static diagrams. Use when authoring or restyling shiori notes.
why_zh: 不重新发明样式，先读库内现有标签和链接习惯再动手；产出的是能融进 vault 的 HTML。
why_en: It reads existing tags and link habits first, then writes compact HTML that belongs in the vault—no orphan pages, no style.
limit_zh: 只认 Shiori vault 的 HTML 笔记；不处理 Markdown、PDF 或外部网页。静态图需你自备文件。
limit_en: Only Shiori vault HTML notes. No Markdown/PDF/web pages. Static diagrams must be supplied by you. Won't retro-restyle old notes.
title_en: HTML note editor that matches your Shiori vault's style
